| `billing.py:5` | `mutable-default` | Change the mutable default arg (list/dict) to `None` and initialize it inside the function body. |
| `billing.py:5` | `missing-docstring` | Add a one-line docstring to the `charge` function describing what it does. |
| `billing.py:8` | `bare-except` | Replace bare `except:` with `except Exception:` (or the specific error type) so `KeyboardInterrupt`/`SystemExit` aren't swallowed. |

The `bare-except` on line 8 is the highest-severity finding — it can silently suppress interpreter shutdown signals and make debugging very hard. The `mutable-default` on line 5 is a classic Python footgun where the default object is shared across all calls.

No parse errors; nothing skipped.
